title: Tutorial Tari Mak Inang Pulau Kampai | Lengkap

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides detailed contextual background and textual descriptions before each dance sequence. They present complete demonstrations of the choreography in a studio setting using two dancers.

lesson_structure.note: Explanation of the history, tempo, and structure of Tari Mak Inang Pulau Kampai

steps_taught.name: Ragam 1
steps_taught.description: Portrays the initial meeting of young people who do not yet know each other.

steps_taught.name: Ragam 2
steps_taught.description: Depicts acquaintances getting to know each other and probing their feelings.

steps_taught.name: Ragam 3
steps_taught.description: Shows the expression of character combined with flower-picking and silat/pencak movements.

steps_taught.name: Ragam 4
steps_taught.description: Represents mutual understanding and seeking parental blessings for marriage.

what_works: Clear textual overlays describing the meaning of each section
Full-body framing of dancers in a clean studio environment
what_hinders: No spoken verbal instructions or breakdown of footwork
Lack of slow-tempo practice or counts spoken aloud

quotes.text: Tari Mak Inang Pulau Kampai merupakan tarian asli penduduk Melayu.
Ragam 1 menggambarkan pertemuan pasangan muda mudi yang belum saling mengenal.

evidence_segments.observation: Text overlay on screen explains the meaning of Ragam 1 while two dancers perform the movements.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer details due to distance

evidence_segments.observation: Dancers transition from standing steps to crouching and stepping in synchronization.

extraction.distinctive_method: Instead of verbal counting or step-by-step breakdown, the instructor relies entirely on written textual explanations of the dance's narrative meaning preceding each full demonstration.
